description:
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Dark Petition, Walk the Aeons, and any number of cards with different mana costs to your hand and putting Seasons Past on the bottom of your library.
Cast Dark Petition by paying {3}{B}{B}, putting Seasons Past from your library into your hand.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn.
Repeat each turn.
